response.sql: SELECT l.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.ALP) as avg_ALP, AVG(l.HCT) as avg_HCT FROM Laboratory l INNER JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID WHERE l.ID IN (SELECT DISTINCT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE `U-PRO` = '-' AND RA = '-') GROUP BY l.ID, p.SEX ORDER BY CASE WHEN AVG(l.HCT) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, AVG(l.HCT) DESC LIMIT 10
